# IJRASET

> IJRASET is a peer-reviewed, open-access international research journal publisher specializing in applied science and engineering technology with UGC approval and fast-track publication services.

IJRASET (International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology) is an established multidisciplinary research publisher indexed across major academic databases including Google Scholar, Crossref, and Thomson Reuters. The platform provides peer-reviewed publication services for researchers globally with emphasis on engineering, technology, and applied sciences.
